blocks.text: «Numerals ending in soft sign (5–20 and 30) are declined like feminine nouns ending in soft sign (**ночь**, **площадь** etc.)» «Note that the Accusative of both animate and inanimate is always the same as the Nominative.»
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 71, p. 32. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.
